global_identity.color_palette: Dark plum #2B1226 as the full flat background; white #FFFFFF for the headline and letter text; hot fuchsia #E6177F and bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 for the bold phrases and the highlighted headline line; bottle black #0E0E10 and hot fuchsia on the bottle; pale blush pink #FBE3EE for the bottom strip; warm gold #D4A23A only for the registration badge border. No offer red in this image (there is no price circle).
global_identity.visual_style: Clean text-letter ad, flat design with one small real phone photo inset and the real bottle as a sharp cut-out.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Calm, honest and reassuring, like a personal note from the brand; warm, never clinical.
global_identity.graphic_language: Flat solid background, generous margins, short left-aligned paragraphs with bold colored phrases, one rounded-corner photo card with a thin fuchsia border, a thin blush bottom strip with a round gold-bordered seal.
global_identity.text_typography: Headline in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look), uppercase; letter body in Poppins Regular with bold phrases in Poppins Bold; signature in an elegant handwritten italic script.

creative_objective: Remove the fear objection: a short, sincere letter from the brand telling the woman who will never go under the knife that there is a natural, simple 3-month plan (2 capsules a day, full treatment, pay on delivery, sanitary registration). Keep the exact text-letter structure of the reference (headline top left, letter on the left 70 %, tilted bottle cut by the right edge, italic signature), adding only the mandatory small photo card with the fitting-room before/after of the glutes in jeans and the thin trust strip at the bottom.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) Big white headline 'SIN AGUJAS. / SIN QUIRÓFANO.' top left. 2) The fitting-room photo card top right (loose jeans gap vs. fitted rounder glutes). 3) The letter paragraphs with their fuchsia bold phrases. 4) The tilted real bottle bottom right. 5) The italic signature and the thin trust strip at the bottom.
art_direction.composition_style: Asymmetric editorial layout like the reference: text column on the left (about 60-65 % width), product column on the right cut by the right edge; a small photo card added in the upper right.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Wide left margin (about 6 % of width), equal spacing between the four paragraphs, generous line height, nothing touching the edges except the bottle that is intentionally cropped by the right edge.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat background with no gradient or a barely visible soft vignette; the bottle has a soft warm key light from the upper left and a gentle shadow; the photo card is warm fitting-room light.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Reference (mv-08): solid dark flat background. Top left (about 20 % of height): a 2-line headline in huge heavy white uppercase. Center left (about 65-70 % of width, 70 % of height): a letter of short paragraphs in white regular sans-serif with some phrases in bold. Center right: one supplement bottle cut-out, slightly tilted, partly cut by the right edge. Bottom left (about 10 %): a signature in italic ('the team…'). No people, no buttons, no price, no strip in the reference. Translated for this product: same background, headline, letter and tilted bottle positions; the bottle moves slightly lower to leave room for the mandatory small rounded photo card in the upper right (before/after of the glutes in jeans, about 25 % of the canvas), and a thin blush strip is added at the very bottom with 'Pagas al recibir' and the registration seal (mandatory brand trust block).

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 text-letter ad on a completely flat dark plum background (#2B1226), editorial asymmetric layout. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. TOP ZONE (0-22 % of height, left 58 % of width): a two-line headline, left aligned with a 6 % margin, in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look), uppercase, tight leading: line 1 'SIN AGUJAS.' in pure white #FFFFFF, line 2 'SIN QUIRÓFANO.' in bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, both large enough to read on a phone. TOP RIGHT (from 4 % to 62 % of height, right 40 % of width, about 25 % of the canvas): a rounded-corner photo card (radius about 24 px) with a thin 3 px hot fuchsia #E6177F border, looking like a real smartphone mirror photo in a small clothing-store fitting room: beige curtain, warm tungsten ceiling light from above, slight phone grain. The card is split vertically into two halves by a thin white line, same adult Latina woman (about 30, long dark wavy hair) seen from the side at hip height, back view toward the mirror. LEFT HALF (before): she wears loose light-blue mom jeans and a plain grey t-shirt; with one hand she pulls the back waistband away from her body by a full fist, showing a clear empty gap and the flat glutes inside; the denim sags and wrinkles under the seat; her face in the mirror looks frustrated, lips pressed. RIGHT HALF (after, another day, different top): the same woman in fitted dark-indigo skinny jeans and a fitted black tank top, confident small smile, the glutes look rounder, fuller and lifted, the denim hugs the hips and glutes with no gap, believable and natural, not exaggerated. Real skin texture with pores, real denim weave and seams. At the bottom edge inside the card a tiny white disclaimer 'Imagen ilustrativa. Los resultados varían.' on a translucent dark band. CENTER LEFT (from 24 % to 82 % of height, left 60 % of width): the letter, four short left-aligned paragraphs in white Poppins Regular, generous line height, equal spacing; key phrases in Poppins Bold hot fuchsia #E6177F or bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 exactly as listed in the text layers. RIGHT LOWER ZONE (from 58 % to 90 % of height): the real product, a matte black cylindrical wide-mouth supplement bottle about 1.6 times taller than wide, glossy hot-pink screw cap almost as wide as the body printed with tiny white 'VITALABH' pattern, hot-pink band on the bottom fifth, black label with the big white condensed word 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1', the pink banner and 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN', facing the camera and legible, never mirrored; it is tilted about 12 degrees clockwise and about 30 % of the canvas height, its right side cut off by the right edge of the image like a cut-out, soft warm key light from upper left, soft shadow, matte finish, no rainbow, no lens flare, cap closed, no capsules. BOTTOM LEFT (82-90 %): signature 'Tu equipo Vitalabh' in an elegant white handwritten italic script. BOTTOM STRIP (last 9 % of height, full width): a thin flat pale blush pink #FBE3EE strip; on the left the text 'Pagas al recibir' in Poppins Bold dark plum #2B1226; on the right a round trust badge with a solid warm gold #D4A23A border and white fill reading 'REGISTRO INVIMA RSA-0030271-2024' in small bold dark plum capitals. No other text, no logos, no price, no urgency.

final_generation_exclusions: No price, no discount, no urgency, no dates, no countdown.
No stars, no review counts, no named testimonials, no doctors or medical imagery.
No loose capsules or pills; the bottle is always closed.
No underwear or bikinis; only jeans.
No extra logos; never write 'AGREGAR', 'LOGO' or 'SELLO DE'.
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers (the bottom strip and the registration badge ARE listed and must appear).
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
